RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50%

An all-male panel is common in senior engineering and not proof of discrimination alone, but homogenous panels carry a known risk of affinity bias. Furthermore, for a group head role, client relationships and business development are legitimate selection criteria that can outweigh additional technical years.

Whether to raise it depends on your goals. Directly alleging gender bias before receiving feedback risks antagonizing leadership and damaging relationships. First, follow up professionally on your requested debrief. If their response is evasive, subjective, or indicates criteria shifted to favor the male candidate, you can then consider raising the lack of panel diversity through HR or consulting an employment specialist.
